metadata.opponent_geometry: conv{0,e_1,...,e_M} in its original Euclidean coordinates
metadata.response: pure active iff r>gamma0/(2*epsilon+gamma0-gamma1); inactive on a tie
metadata.response_weights: Equal positive weights on all coordinates; normalization does not change the minimizer
metadata.full_target: {0} before any request; thereafter resource coordinates nonnegative, A=sum(resource), E>=0, 2*A+E<=beta, supported on observed resources
metadata.safe_base: unchanged original K=2 SafeBlockLearner, exact sparse state recurrence
metadata.fast_oracles: exact origin projection of each fresh unit resource; exact energy-direction saddle with observed-origin dual tie break
metadata.fast_dual_tie_rule: Select the observed origin among dual saddle optima; this is a fixed valid oracle choice, not a claim that every generic LP solver selects the same optimum
metadata.alternate_fast_dual_tie_rule: fast_recent_saddle selects an observed request after the first one; otherwise origin. Its benchmark energy witness is gamma1 after a past request and zero before; projected-current origin energy is gamma0*p
metadata.safe_compression: aggregate/energy dual coordinates plus full resource-dual squared norm; disjoint new-resource block updates preserve the original Euclidean ball projection
metadata.environment_information: past capacities only; current action and private learner state are not read
metadata.curve_distances: all-round analytic lower/upper enclosures of the FULL strict target; prechange exact; terminal full-target KKT projection with support/feasibility diagnostics
metadata.physical_weighted_cost: 2*aggregate deficit + provisioning cost, equal unnormalized component weights
metadata.request_trigger: Causal heuristic: off after first uniform action until the first request, then fixed balanced_capacity=beta/gamma0; no safety certificate claimed
metadata.rng: default_rng(SeedSequence([base_entropy,scenario_id,episode_seed])); same theta and uniforms across methods
limitations: Constructed large-resource mechanism model, not a real-world data population.
Reactive policies generate different paths and strict targets; paired common innovations do not make paths identical.
The fixed catalog has truly distinct resource-deficit coordinates; large realized dimension is deliberate, with no low-dimensional rate or q=4 validation.
The fast dynamics depend on the disclosed origin dual-saddle tie rule; other valid saddle tie rules can behave differently.
All-round distance enclosures are oracle uncertainty, not sampling confidence intervals.
Provisioning cost models idle reservation waste and loaded overhead, not measured total electrical energy.
The target distance, unmet demand, provisioning cost and per-round payoff norm are different outcomes.
Finite floating arithmetic is checked numerically, not formally certified exact arithmetic.
